messages:
marta: quick thought for console analytics: surface automated filter recommendations per-route that bundle model + telemetry constraints as a "filter set" users can preview and save as a saved-query. want to capture tradeoffs before I file a proposal.

kyle: love it. are these computed continuously or scheduled? also how expensive is the compute?

marta: hybrid approach: stream-derived candidates + nightly aggregator to rank. stream flags cheap heuristics; nightly job runs heavier simulations. store suggestions as compact records.

priya: what signals? i propose: recent P50/P95 latency deltas per model, model-level error rate from eval hooks, and route-level traffic skew (percent of requests hitting non-default models). combine with ownership heuristics.

rachel: UX: show a compact tile that includes expected cost delta, expected latency delta, and a confidence band. let users toggle between "preview sample" and "apply canary".

marta: agreed. API prototype for preview:

```
POST /api/v1/routes/{id}/filter-sets/preview
body: { "candidates": ["model:small-quant","region:eu"], "window": "48h", "simulate": true }
returns: { "est_cost_delta_pct": 12.3, "latency_ms": { "p50": 20, "p95": 85 }, "ci": { "cost": [8.1,16.7], "p95": [70,100] }, "n_samples": 412 }
```

priya: must expose n_samples and CI 👍. otherwise PMs assume exact numbers. also flag when sample includes cold-start bias.

kyle: approval flow: anything that increases cost >10% or changes model class (small -> large) needs finance/owner approval. otherwise owner can fast-apply a canary.

marta: propose three apply modes: preview (local-only, no audit event), canary (10% traffic, audit + auto-monitor), full (immediate, requires approval for costly changes). each apply emits events: suggestion_id, mode, user, snapshot_id.

rachel: how does this interact with saved queries? if user saves a suggested filter-set, we should create a linked saved-query with provenance metadata and a pin on the route view so other owners see it. saved-query should be editable but show original suggestion badge.

ops-bot: stream-agg-job: suggestions for route r-web computed (job=stream-agg-20240321-9).

priya: also enforce visibility controls: owner-drafts vs org-shared suggestions. default to owner-drafts. org-shared suggestions require opt-in and an audit trail.

kyle: telemetry/metrics capture: record pre/post histograms for latency and tokens, plus request samples (PII-sanitized) that demonstrate the filter's effect. store small trace for repro.

marta: agree. store a compact scoring trace: input signals, weights, and raw deltas. searchable by suggestion_id.

rachel: rollouts UX: in canary mode show a live small chart (p50/p95 and token burn) and a one-click rollback. make the chart lightweight (sparklines) and link to full route telemetry.

priya: one edge: suggested filters that reduce model set can unintentionally reduce coverage for certain prompt types. we should compute a coverage score using a small prompt-set sample and show a "coverage risk" warning.

marta: good catch. add coverage_risk: { level: low|medium|high, examples: ["prompt sample A"] } in preview payload.

kyle: last item: metrics for suggestions themselves. we should track adoption %, avg cost delta realized, and false-positive rate (suggested -> reverted within 24h). ops can use that to tweak heuristics.

marta: perfect. I'll write an RFC with: data model for suggestion records, preview API, apply flow (preview/canary/full), visibility controls, and telemetry/audit schema. can someone pick up a 2d spike for a mock console panel?

rachel: I'll prototype a compact panel this week.

marta: thanks everyone — opening RFC now. :white_check_mark:
